confirmedFindings.statement: The B02 production sequence invokes scripts/lafea-b02d-probe-stable-polar-mesh-check.mjs; that check is bound to B02D-lug-pinhole.json (V1), while scripts/lafea-b02d-production-check.mjs is bound to B02D-lug-pinhole-v2.json and documents V1 as superseded by V2.
confirmedFindings.consequence: A failing V1 polar-mesh precursor cannot be treated as evidence that the current V2 B02D production qualification is wrong.

confirmedFindings.statement: Issue #1862 remains unadmitted. The current EP authorizes evidence writes only under relay/EVIDENCE/C3D-BASELINE/** and prohibits production mechanics, benchmark/oracle/tolerance, mesher, recovery and result-authority changes.

reportedButNotYetProviderDurable.statement: Local execution reports all four primary commands returned exit code 1 and reports individual B02A/B02C/B02D passes plus a B02B T3 ~8% versus 5% criterion failure.
Local execution reports T6/nu=0.3/L1 regular B-bar mesh quality blocked and BM-005 oscillatory convergence/publication failure.

correctionsRequired: Do not classify the B02B T3 7.999% versus frozen 5% result as a bad tolerance or benchmark definition without proving T3 applicability/authority. Do not relax the tolerance.

Do not classify BM-005 OSCILLATORY / RESULT_NOT_READY as a benchmark-definition defect merely because it prevents a green aggregate. Treat it as a genuine convergence/publication result until its first owning boundary is demonstrated.
Do not classify the B-bar T6/L1 mesh-quality block as a benchmark-definition defect until raw evidence and the intended supported mesh/envelope are reconciled.
Downgrade deterministic replay to PARTIAL/NOT_DURABLY_PROVED unless the replay script plus two-pass output are retained under relay/EVIDENCE/C3D-BASELINE/**.

Replace the over-broad single disposition OWNING_GAP:benchmark_definition with separate confirmed/unresolved findings: confirmed stale B02D V1 sequence binding; unresolved B02B T3 qualification envelope; unresolved B-bar T6/L1 mesh-quality boundary; unresolved BM-005 convergence/publication boundary; and a separately evidenced receipt-projection gap.
resolutionConditions: Push the exact local BASELINE-0001 evidence directory into relay/EVIDENCE/C3D-BASELINE/BASELINE-0001/, including the four primary stdout/stderr/exit receipts, execution-summary.json, field-completeness.json, protected-diff.txt, disposition.json and observations.md.
Retain the deterministic replay script and its two independent raw execution outputs under the admitted evidence path, or explicitly downgrade replay to not durably proved.
Revise the disposition so confirmed source-binding defects are separated from unresolved numerical/mesh/convergence findings; no oracle/tolerance weakening may be proposed as a shortcut.
Re-run independent review against repository-visible evidence. CHECKPOINT may proceed only when the HIGH_RISK quality result is CLEAR.

successorPolicy.nextCandidate: A narrow diagnostic/reconciliation EP may be proposed only after this baseline is durably checkpointable; receipt projection should remain a separate later EP from numerical/mesh/convergence diagnosis.
